page.overview:
Who is Kayvaan Shrike?

Kayvaan Shrike (KAY-van shrighk) is a famed officer of the Raven Guard Chapter. A former Shadow Captain of the Raven Guard's 3rd Company, Shrike later served as the Raven Guard Master of Shadows (Chapter Master) in the wake of the Prefectia Campaign of 999.M41 when the former Raven Guard Chapter Master, Corvin Severax, and a large contingent of the 3rd Company were slain in a T'au ambush.

Shrike resigned during the Era Indomitus as the Master of Shadows in favour of a Raven Guard Astartes he felt better embodied Primarch Corvus Corax's Trifold Path of Shadow tactical teachings, Aethon Shaan, and took up a new role commanding a Raven Guard campaign against the Tyranids of Hive Fleet Leviathan assaulting the Bastior Sub-sector in the Fourth Tyrannic War.

A master of stealth and infiltration as a devotee of his primarch's Path of Ambush, Kayvaan Shrike strikes from the darkness, fast and lethal. By the time his foes can react, it is already too late and darkness has claimed them.

Shrike was born on the Imperial Forge World of Kiavahr, and as a boy, demonstrated a preternatural ability for stealth and espionage. As a youth, he worked as a runner for the Tarkal Guild, a gang that operated within the hive city Shrike lived in. But it was an incident in his late teenage years that set him on the path to destiny -- he had been pursued by a rival gang for solar days on end.
